name: Pedro Espíndula
whoAmI: Staff Site Reliability Engineer with 5+ years in SRE at Brazilian fintech and payments companies, focused on observability, incident response and the cost of reliability.

At Cora, rolled out alerting and on-call to 100% of engineering teams, raising alert acknowledgement from 17% to 85% and cutting critical-alert MTTA from 12 to 4 minutes, and consolidated observability onto Datadog for $67K in yearly savings.
At Pagar.me (StoneCo), cut MTTA by 70% and MTTR by 55%.
